overall_reason: The guidelines page is set entirely in Vercel's Geist greys: a #0a0a0a paper, #ededed body ink (--ds-gray-1000), #a1a1a1 muted text (--ds-gray-900) and #ffffff for the ten section headings (--geist-foreground), with #1a1a1a code chips as the only raised surface; every colour traces to the design system's tokens and holds one role.

score.reason: T-COLOUR-SOURCE, T-PALETTE-ROLES, T-NEUTRALS and T-DARK-MODE pass: what was cut is every chromatic colour (the area palette is 100% neutral), leaving three text levels and one lighter chip surface on a dark paper, which suits a Read page.

strengths: Three text levels with fixed jobs: #ffffff for the ten section headings ("Interactions", "Animations", "Forms"), #ededed for the bold rule names and body (139 elements), #a1a1a1 for the explanatory text (284 elements), all defined as Geist tokens on :root (tiles/1440-00.png, tiles/1440-05.png).
Neutrals are untinted throughout: the table counts 523 untinted neutrals, 0 warm and 0 cool, so nothing drifts in temperature.

The dark theme steps up, not down: the paper is #0a0a0a and the inline code chips are #1a1a1a with a #292929 hairline, with no surface darker than the canvas, no shadows doing the lifting and no filter: invert.
Links are marked by an underline as well as tone, so they survive the grayscale fold (03-lenses/color/gray-fold-1440.png).
not_investigated: T-LINE-DELETION: the page has no repeated rules or borders apart from the code-chip outlines, which mark code, so the test has nothing to remove.
The light theme: the stylesheet declares color-scheme and a theme class, but the capture rendered the dark scheme only, so the light theme is not verified.
CLR-009: #ffffff on the section headings is the documented --geist-foreground token, so it is not a finding (conflict C09).
The focus_ring Floor hits (A11-003) belong to the sweep and lens-a11y and are not repeated.
